name: Harming Children
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to us as His reward and blessing (Psalms 127:3). Believers are called to diligently train children in godly ways, ensuring their faith endures throughout life (Proverbs 22:6). Christ sternly warns against causing harm or offense to these little ones who believe in Him, emphasizing the grave consequences for those who do so (Matthew 18:6; Mark 9:42). Moreover, Jesus values and welcomes children, affirming their special place in the kingdom and the attentive care of their angels before the Father (Matthew 18:10; Mark 10:13).
